title: Continuous Dual Maximizers for Fixed-Reference Entropy-Regularized Wasserstein Barycenters
summary: We study the fixed-reference entropy-regularized Wasserstein barycenter problem, in which a probability measure $η$ on the barycenter space is chosen before optimization and the $i$th transport plan is regularized relative to $ν_i\otimesη$. Earlier work established a dual formulation for this model and equality between the primal and dual optimal values. However, equality of values does not by itself guarantee that the dual supremum is achieved.
